healthDataSync.title: Health Data to Sync
healthDataSync.appleHealthSummary: Reads selected data from Apple Health and syncs it to your self-hosted server.
healthDataSync.healthConnectSummary: Reads selected data from Health Connect and syncs it to your self-hosted server.
healthDataSync.appleHealthDetail:
SparkyFitness reads the health data you select below using Apple Health (HealthKit). If sync is enabled, data is synchronized only between your device and your self-hosted SparkyFitness server (manual or background).

Manage or remove access in Settings → Health → Data Access & Devices → SparkyFitnessMobile
healthDataSync.healthConnectDetail: SparkyFitness reads the health data you select below using Health Connect. If sync is enabled, data is synchronized only between your device and your self-hosted SparkyFitness server (manual or background).
healthDataSync.medicalAdviceDetail: Consult a healthcare professional for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
healthDataSync.batteryNotice: Enabling many health metrics may increase battery usage. Each enabled metric allows the app to wake in the background when new data is available.
